annotation.summary_en: An elderly couple fights over the TV remote as the wife insists on watching her soap opera over her husband's football match, leading to a surprising confrontation with the devil.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: In a yellow-wallpapered bedroom at night, an elderly couple sits in bed arguing over the television. The wife, Azgush (played by a male actor in drag with round glasses and a wig), wants to watch her 'clone' soap opera so she can gossip with the neighbors. The husband, in striped pajamas and holding a cane, pleads to watch a football replay, calling it his only joy. Azgush stubbornly refuses, claiming she is a 'principled woman.' The husband manages to grab the remote, leading to a 'remote revolution' where they physically struggle and trade insults. After he finally switches to the match, Azgush spitefully spoils the result, revealing it was a 0-0 draw, ruining his excitement. The scene then shifts to a darker, floral-wallpapered bedroom where the man lies alone. A devil with horns and a black cape appears over him with glowing red hands. When the devil asks why the man isn't afraid, the man delivers the punchline: he has been married to the devil's sister for 36 years, so nothing scares him anymore.
catchphrases: Բայց ես ձեր քրոջ հետ արդեն 36 տարի է ամուսնացած եմ։
